video_title: LEGEND IN THE MAKING: Jacob Misiorowski is LEADING Milwaukee towards the post-season

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on the experience of pulling his own baseball cards
quotes.excerpt: I got to try and pull myself. And they had single packs and stuff.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: I was going to ask about your hobbies too. Is this what you do on your off day?

text_blocks.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
text_blocks.text: Huge. Huge. I love Pokemon. They had a box of my first ever card, my draft class from 22. They had a box up top and I was like, I got to try. I got to try and pull myself. And they had single packs and stuff. By this time they realized who I am and they start giving me packs. It was like the third pack in and all of a sudden it was just boom, there it is.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on opening baseball card packs with teammates
quotes.excerpt: Reese brought out a few weeks after that just brought out a random base set packs.

text_blocks.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
text_blocks.text: Reese brought out a few weeks after that just brought out a random base set packs and we were just like, Reese, what are we doing? He is like, we are going to open them. And then that is when that video also of me opening the Charizard, that was Reese's pack. And Reese was like, yeah, we are opening. So me, Woo, and Reese all opened a pack and now it is on the line, I pulled that.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: He does not matter if it is a baseball pack, NBA pack, I am having him too. I am going to have you all open all of them.

text_blocks.speaker: Gruber
text_blocks.text: Between that and the Yelich and the one box they gave us, that is awesome.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on his philanthropic work with the Wisconsin Parkinson Association
quotes.excerpt: I am working with the Wisconsin Parkinson Association, which helps people with Parkinsons.
quotes.quote: I am working with the Wisconsin Parkinson Association, which helps people with Parkinsons and finding resources and other things like that to help with that disease. It hits really close to home for me, for my dad has Parkinsons and has been diagnosed for a while now. So it is an awesome cause to help out and support him.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on the difference between minor and major league facilities
quotes.excerpt: The lower you get, the worse stuff you get, but it is still nice stuff.

text_blocks.speaker: Thanasis Antetokounmpo
text_blocks.text: Did you feel the same in the minor leagues or you feel like this is more and it is like?

text_blocks.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
text_blocks.text: Way more. Our minor leagues were really nice, especially the one in Appleton, Wisconsin up here. It is kind of new. The lower you get, the worse stuff you get, but it is still nice stuff. You are still comparing to a D2 college. It is nice, but it is definitely a downgrade from the levels you go up. And so you see as you get closer and closer you are like, oh, this is what we are going for.

text_blocks.speaker: Gruber
text_blocks.text: They have a machine that shoots brats into the stands. They are wrapped and they shoot them off into the stand.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on the importance of personal dedication in baseball
quotes.excerpt: I do not think money really means all that much in baseball at least.
quotes.quote: I do not think money really means all that much in baseball at least. I think it is more the person. You have to be willing to sacrifice not going to do stuff in the off season and you got to go workout, you got to do this. There is stuff that coming through, especially in college and stuff, you had to be like, you are doing this, this is what is going to happen and I am going to make it and you got to devote yourself to it.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on staying connected to his father while traveling
quotes.excerpt: My dad retired early and so he would drive me around and go to baseball practices.
quotes.quote: My dad retired early and so he would drive me around and go to baseball practices and lessons and all that stuff growing up and so it was time that I spent with him in the car and truck and we just talked and were together. So I think that was the biggest one.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on his dream matchups against Adam Wainwright and Clayton Kershaw
quotes.excerpt: It was Adam Wainwright and then he retired and then it came Kershaw.
quotes.quote: It was Adam Wainwright and then he retired and then it came Kershaw and it was like and then it actually happened and it was like holy cow. It was a third start. I mean, it was crazy. I mean, going through the minors, getting to know the guys, it was like Paul Skenes would be really cool to face and got to face him. That was another cool one.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on the significance of his jersey number 32
quotes.excerpt: I wore 32 my whole career. In college I was 32.
quotes.quote: I wore 32 my whole career. In college I was 32, all that. So it was just the number I have been. And then yeah, I get up here, 33 is what I get and then Savalli gets traded the next day or two days later or something like that and made a phone call and made sure it was okay, but yeah.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on maintaining his composure on the mound
quotes.excerpt: Just looking down kind of cooled me off and like call me down a little bit.
quotes.quote: Just looking down kind of cooled me off and like call me down a little bit, seeing like, okay, this is this isn't anything different, same game, same number, same, you know, just keep doing it.

quotes.speaker: Jacob Misiorowski
quotes.summary_phrase: Jacob Misiorowski on his confidence when facing major league hitters
quotes.excerpt: I just struck out so and so like I just struck out the Dodgers.
quotes.quote: I understand where they are coming from, but at the same time like I just struck out so and so like I just struck out the Dodgers or did I got out of an inning against the Dodgers. Come try to do it, you know, you are not going to succeed.
